spec.description:
Fletcher Pink Partition insulation is a lightweight to
medium-density glasswool insulation batt specifically designed for commercial
steel and timber framed partition walls and ceilings. Manufactured from FBS-1
bio-soluble glasswool with up to 80% recycled glass content, it delivers
tailored acoustic attenuation and thermal comfort across low- and high-rise
commercial fitouts, offices, healthcare, aged care, and multi-residential
projects. With densities ranging from 11 kg/m³ to 32 kg/m³ and thicknesses up
to 165mm (R1.2 to R3.5), it is non-combustible and maintains cavity firmness to
prevent slumping.
features:
Engineered specifically for commercial steel
and timber stud partition walls and ceilings

Wide range of densities
available: 11 kg/m³, 14 kg/m³, 24 kg/m³, and 32 kg/m³

Non-combustible
material when tested in accordance with AS 1530.1

Reduces background noise
and airborne sound transmission between offices and tenancies

Thermal
insulation performance with R-values ranging from R1.2 up to R3.5

Firm
friction fit ensures insulation remains in position without slumping over time
Manufactured from up to 80% recycled glass with bio-soluble FBS-1 formulation
CodeMark certified (Certificate of Conformity CM 30006) for NCC compliance

Suitable for healthcare, aged care, education, office, and transport hub
fitouts
Backed by Fletcher Insulation 50-year commercial warranty

install:
Ensure framing studs are
erected and cavity spaces are dry and clear of debris

Select batt dimensions
matching stud width (450mm or 600mm)

Friction-fit Pink Partition batts snugly
between steel or timber studs

Ensure batts butt tightly against top and
bottom tracks and adjacent batts with zero gaps

Cut neatly around electrical
conduits, plumbing, and wall penetrations using a serrated knife

Maintain
batt thickness to match cavity depth without crushing or over-compressing

Fasten plasterboard or wall lining according to fire and acoustic system
specifications
selection_checklist:
Identify target acoustic
specification (Rw / STC) and select density (11, 14, 24, or 32 kg/m³)

Check fire rating requirements (AS 1530.1 non-combustible
compliance)
Order matching pack quantities based on area calculations
limitations:
For internal wall cavities and commercial partitions; not for
direct external weather exposure

Avoid severe compression beyond cavity
thickness
Must not be installed over unsealed damp surfaces

use_cases:
Acoustic and thermal dampening in
commercial steel-stud office partition walls

Sound containment in healthcare,
hospital consulting rooms, and aged care facilities

Acoustic partition infill
in schools, university lecture halls, and transport terminal facilities
not_for: Direct HVAC duct interior acoustic lining
retrieval.rag_summary:
Fletcher Pink
Partition is a commercial glasswool acoustic and thermal insulation range
manufactured in Australia by Fletcher Insulation for steel and timber stud
partitions and ceilings. Available in densities of 11, 14, 24, and 32 kg/m³ and
thicknesses from 50mm to 165mm (R1.2 to R3.5), it delivers customizable sound
transmission control (Rw / STC) across commercial offices, healthcare, aged
care, and educational institutions. Non-combustible to AS 1530.1, CodeMark
certified (CM 30006), and containing up to 80% recycled glass, Pink Partition
maintains rigid friction-fit cavity stability backed by a 50-year commercial
warranty.
